# stratusphere/scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Deploys, checks, fixes and cleans up the Stratusphere appliances in Azure: Hub, Database, Collectors.

One entry point for every role. -Role picks the appliances; -Action what to do with them: Plan (default) what Deploy would change (what-if), plus the plan and terms checks. Changes nothing. Check resource group, each appliance (exists, running, static IP), NSG rules, egress, Key Vault and its credential, Marketplace terms. Ends with RESULT PASS or FAIL. Deploy registers providers, accepts the terms, recovers a soft-deleted Key Vault, and deploys the template with the appliances asked for plus the ones that already exist. The appliance password is generated once, kept in Key Vault and reused on later runs. Fix runs Check, then only what repairs it: accept terms, recover the vault, redeploy (puts back a missing VM, a dynamic IP, a failed provisioning, NSG rules), start stopped VMs. Then checks again. Anything it can't repair safely is listed. Cleanup -Role Collector or Database removes those VMs (disks and NICs go with them). -Role Hub removes the whole environment, including the peering on the other VNet. Asks for confirmation (-Force skips it); -WhatIf lists what would go. Liquidware advises a Database appliance above 1,000 Connector ID Keys. Collectors are optional. After deploying a Database or Collectors, point them at the Hub in their consoles (docs/appliances.md). The Marketplace plan (SKU) of each role comes from -HubPlan, -DatabasePlan and -CollectorPlan; for roles already deployed it is read from the VM. List the plans offered in a region with: ./scripts/ops/Test-StratusphereReadiness.ps1 -Location eastus2

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |

| `-NoBastion` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-AutoShutdownTime` | string | no | `'2000'` |  |
| `-ShutdownAfterMinutes` | int | no | `0` | Optional deadline auto-shutdown (G1 Deallocate) and auto-teardown (G2 Delete) in aa-avdlz-runs. |
| `-TeardownAfterMinutes` | int | no | `0` |  |
| `-BatchId` | string | no | `''` |  |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 -Action Deploy -HubPlan <plan>
```
```powershell
./scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 -Action Deploy -Role Database,Collector -DatabasePlan <plan> -CollectorPlan <plan> -CollectorCount 2
```
```powershell
./scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 -Action Check
./scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 -Action Fix
```
```powershell
./scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 -Action Cleanup -Role Collector
./scripts/ops/Deploy-Stratusphere.ps1 -Action Cleanup -Role Hub -WhatIf
(a real Cleanup of the Hub or Database also needs -DiscardLastCopy, once the assessment data is exported)
```
